title: Page 6
lines: 啪啪啪……啪啪啪……
快节奏的敲打键盘声像无形的摩斯密码，紧张情绪随着不间断的敲键声，迅速地在有限的大楼空间内往上高筑。
公关部办公室内几乎所有员工都在挑灯夜战，大家脸上显露着焦虑、惊惶、战战兢兢各种情绪。
这天下午下了一场大雨，凹凸不平的路面多出许多小水洼，这办公室里的人却没有一个人知道，稍早前一墙之外的世界发生了什么事。
从电梯出来进入公关部大办公室，直走到底右转，一间个人办公室内，也同样弥漫着紧张气氛。
「如斯，快到了没？」说话声音从耳机里传出来。
「等我完成手边的工作……」孙如斯戴着耳机讲手机，双眼盯着电脑萤幕，两手在键盘上快速移动。
明天新任老板就要上任，所谓新官上任三把火，明天肯定有场大战，今晚必须把所有资料准备齐全，不能让新老板留下他们一问三不知的恶劣印象。
「我相亲快来不及了。」于舞能的声音听起来很紧张。
「马上来！」如斯把待处理的工作存档，而后抓起笔电，冲出办公室，搭乘电梯，快步踏出大楼。
她动作流畅地跳上一辆计程车，报了目的地的地址后，一边讲电话，一边
她已经把这两年艺廊卖出的各类作品做好分类和分析，再把近年的人民币当成变项加入，但这些只是基础工作。
今晚上床睡觉前，她必须要把近五年的资料整理妥当，同时祈祷新任老板只会追溯了解到此，千万不要一来就企图心强大，想综览十年来的所有市场变化。
快速动作间，如斯仰望一眼天空，无声叹口气，心中忍不住感慨，世界如此美好，我却如此暴躁……
没多久，计程车停在一间餐厅门口，她付帐下车，刚抬脚往前踏出一步，三、四辆跑车伴随超强引擎声嚣张呼啸而过，轮胎驶过小水洼，污水飞溅而起，她微微瞠大双眼，想收回踏出的脚往后退，只可惜来不及了，啪的一声，污水打上她雪白的紧身长裤，留下斑斑污点，也点燃她眼底的熊熊怒火。
从哪里冒出来的妖魔鬼怪，到底会不会开车？！
见几辆跑车停在前方不远处的停车格里，从车里跳下几名说说笑笑的男男女女，男的笑声超大，女的裙子超短。
其中有一名高冷男人特别吸引人的目光，无论他身边的人怎么笑闹，他的脸上始终挂着讽刺浅笑，好像纵容着这一切，又彷佛他亦沉溺在这放纵的氛围里，且他长相俊帅，完全是个撕漫男。
如斯想上前理论，便听见身后传来大学时代最要好闺蜜于舞能兴奋的说话声—
「宝贝，你终于来了！」
于舞能站在餐厅门口，朝她张开双臂，神情有些急躁，看得出来她恨不得能插翅飞到另一个地方。
如斯同样张开双臂，两人一见面便先来个大熊抱。
「相亲还来得及吧？」如斯瞅着她问道。
算了，放那些人一马，别再让她遇到，否则一定让他们吃吃苦头，更不能因为这批没水准的人，耽误舞能的人生大事。
「可以。」于舞能左手抓着手机，显然时时刻刻注意着时间。
如斯往后退一步，欣赏于舞能精心打扮后的模样。「这件战袍还可以啊。」
染成浅褐色的长发绑成公主头，脸上画着现下最流行的彩妆，身穿全白洋装，衣版很挺，人看起来很有精神。
「最新一季香奈儿新款，能差到哪里去？」于舞能收到赞美，马上当场转一圈，白洋装裙摆往上飘浮。
「对方什么来头，居然让你这样下重本？」
「我妈说是什么集团大老板，出门身边有保镳的那种。」于舞能看了眼手机萤幕显示的时间。「不说了，等我今晚回来再聊，有事可以跟高大哥商量，工读生们任你差遣，你只动口不动手，OK？」
「又不是第一次帮你顾餐厅，去吧！」如斯微微一笑，对着于舞能挥挥手。
其实舞能之前曾有过一名论及婚嫁的男友，后来因为发生一些不好的事，她极力说服于母和自己站在同一阵线，与对方解除婚约，而当初说好的条件是，她必须在两年之内把自己嫁掉。
「那我走了啊。」于舞能往外移动一步，想想不对，又忍不住回过头道：「餐厅这个月的业绩还差十多万才到我妈规定的目标，你点子多，帮我想想怎么把业绩冲上去。」
于舞能的母亲是个千金小姐，父亲是老师，于舞能大学毕业后曾到几间公司工作过，最后决定自行创业，开了这间「亲爱的」餐馆。
餐馆的大股东是她的母亲，她只看营业额，其余经营方面都不插手，正式营业前母女曾约定好，如果餐厅没有好好经营或经营不善要立刻收掉，以免赔太多。
「今天已经三十号了。」如斯把日期记得很清楚，毕竟明天是新任老板驾到的日子。
距离下个月只剩不到四小时，就算她是齐天大圣孙悟空，也没办法在这么短的时间内让餐厅赚进十几万块。
「拜托你了！没达到业绩，我妈会把餐厅收回去交给专业经理人打理，到时候我什么都没有，人生会很无聊。」于舞能人生只有两件事要忙，一是顾好这间餐厅，二是积极把自己嫁掉。
「与其把希望放在我身上，不如你好好相亲，等你好消息。」如斯拍拍好友的肩膀。
「果然英雌所见略同。」于舞能说完，朝她挥挥手后跳上一辆计程车。
计程车迅速驶离现场，却没有人注意到后方有一辆黑色轿车尾随其后。
如斯大步踏进餐厅，经过前庭户外花园区，熟门熟路地直接走进装潢欧风的柜台。
柜台里，站着今晚负责结帐的餐厅人员和餐厅主厨高大哥。
「如斯，来啦？」高大哥一身雪白的厨师装，双手叉腰，看见如斯，严肃的长方形脸孔笑了起来，露出一口白牙。
「高大哥。」如斯先将手里的东西放到柜台下方的层架上，接过他递过来的黑色围裙制服，快速的穿上。「晚上生意如何？」
「客人三三两两，不过有一组订位。」高大哥不用看单子，当天有几组客人订位、人数多少他都了然于心。
「几人？」
「十三个人。」
如斯轻皱一下眉头后松开，心里开始打起算盘，十三个人要冲破十万简直是天方夜谭。
「喏，来了。」高大哥朝门口努努嘴。
如斯转头看向他指示的方向，等看清来人，她先是一愣，两秒钟后嘴角慢慢往上扬，抽起柜台上的菜单，左手往正要前往招呼的服务生肩膀轻压一下，轻哼了句「我去」，随即踩着自信的步伐出征。
「你们好，请问要点什么？」
如斯正想把餐厅菜单发下去，一名满头乱糟糟卷发的男人看着她摆摆手，表示不用发菜单。
「把你们餐厅最好吃的菜品全部上过一轮！今晚不醉不归！」卷发男脸微红，情绪很兴奋。
「没错，今晚来庆祝就是要海吃海喝一顿！」
其他人兴致高昂的附议，有人甚至还高举右手握拳。
唯独那个高冷男静静坐在椅子上，从头到尾不发一语，神情看起来是这群人当中最冷静的，嘴角挂着招牌嘲讽浅笑。
「你们是指隐藏式菜单里的菜品吗？」如斯看着这群人，脑中突然灵光一闪，笑意慢慢浮现。

Chapter 1(1)
Bang bang bang... bang bang bang...
The sound of fast-paced typing on the keyboard is like invisible Morse code. With the uninterrupted sound of typing keys, the tension quickly builds up in the limited space of the building.
Almost all employees in the Public Relations Department office are working late at night, and everyone's faces show various emotions of anxiety, panic, and trembling.
It rained heavily that afternoon, and there were many small puddles on the uneven road. But no one in the office knew what happened in the world outside the wall earlier.
Exit the elevator and enter the public relations department's large office. Go straight to the end and turn right. There is also a tense atmosphere in a personal office.
"So, are we almost there?" A voice came from the earphones.
"Wait until I finish the work at hand..." Sun Rusi wore headphones and talked on her mobile phone, staring at the computer screen and moving her hands quickly on the keyboard.
Tomorrow the new boss will take office. The so-called three things a new official will do when he takes office is that there will definitely be a battle tomorrow. All the information must be prepared tonight so that the new boss can't leave a bad impression that they don't know everything.
"It's almost too late for me to go on a blind date." Yu Wuneng's voice sounded nervous.
"Come right now!" He archived the work to be done, then grabbed his laptop, rushed out of the office, took the elevator, and quickly walked out of the building.
She jumped into a taxi smoothly, gave the address of her destination, and talked on the phone.
She has classified and analyzed the various works sold by the gallery in the past two years, and then added the RMB in recent years as a variable, but these are just basic work.
Before going to bed tonight, she must sort out the information of the past five years, and pray that the new boss will only understand this retrospectively, and must not be ambitious and want to overview all the market changes in the past ten years.
In a quick movement, I looked up at the sky, sighed silently, and couldn't help but sigh in my heart, the world is so beautiful, but I am so irritable...
Not long after, the taxi stopped in front of a restaurant. She paid the bill and got out. Just as she took a step forward, three or four sports cars roared past with the sound of super powerful engines. Their tires passed through small puddles, and sewage splashed up. She widened her eyes slightly and tried to retract her step and step back, but it was too late. With a pop, the sewage hit her snow-white tights, leaving stains and igniting the raging anger in her eyes.
Can the monsters and ghosts that appear from nowhere know how to drive? !
I saw several sports cars parked in the parking space not far ahead. A few men and women jumped out of the cars, talking and laughing. The men's laughter was very loud, and the women's skirts were very short.
Among them, there was a cold man who attracted special attention. No matter how the people around him laughed and laughed, he always had a sarcastic smile on his face, as if he indulged all this, and as if he was also indulged in this indulgent atmosphere. Moreover, he looked handsome and was completely a ruthless man.
As I was about to step forward to argue, I heard the excited voice of my best friend in college, Yu Wu Neng, coming from behind—
"Baby, you're finally here!"
Yu Wuneng stood at the door of the restaurant, opening his arms towards her, looking a little impatient. It was obvious that she wished she could spread her wings and fly to another place.
Opening their arms in the same way, the two of them gave each other a big bear hug as soon as they met.
"Is it still too late for a blind date?" Rusi looked at her and asked.
Forget it, let those people go and don't let her encounter them again, otherwise they will definitely suffer. Let's not delay the important life event of dancing because of these unqualified people.
"Okay." Yu Wuneng held the phone in his left hand, obviously paying attention to the time.
Take a step back like this and admire Yu Daneng's carefully dressed appearance. "This shirt is okay."
Her long hair, dyed light brown, was tied into a princess hairstyle, her face was painted with the most popular makeup, and she was wearing an all-white dress. The clothes were very straight, and she looked very energetic.
"How can the latest Chanel style be any worse?" Yu Wu Neng received the compliment and immediately spun around on the spot, with the hem of her white dress floating upward.
"What kind of background does the other party have that makes you pay such a heavy price?"
"My mother said he was the big boss of some kind of group, the kind who has bodyguards around him when he goes out." Yu Wuneng glanced at the time displayed on the phone screen. "Stop talking, we'll talk about it when I come back tonight. If you have anything, you can discuss it with Brother Gao. The work-study students are at your disposal. You just talk but don't do anything, okay?"
"It's not the first time I've helped you take care of the restaurant, go ahead!" Rusi smiled slightly and waved to Yu Wuneng.
In fact, Wu Neng once had a boyfriend who was talking about getting married. Later, because something bad happened, she tried her best to persuade her mother to stand with her and break off the engagement. The original condition was that she must marry herself within two years.
"Then I'm leaving." Yu Wu was able to take a step outside. She thought something was wrong, but couldn't help but look back and said, "The restaurant's sales this month are still more than 100,000 yuan short of the target set by my mother. You have many ideas. Help me figure out how to increase the sales."
Yu Wuneng's mother is a rich girl and her father is a teacher. After graduating from university, Yu Wuneng worked in several companies. Finally, she decided to start her own business and opened this "dear" restaurant.
The major shareholder of the restaurant is her mother. She only looks at the turnover and does not interfere in other aspects of the operation. Before the official opening, mother and daughter made an agreement that if the restaurant is not well run or poorly managed, it must be closed immediately to avoid losing too much.
"Today is already the 30th." I remember the date clearly. After all, tomorrow is the day when the new boss will arrive.
There are less than four hours left until next month. Even if she is the Monkey King, there is no way she can make the restaurant more than 100,000 yuan in such a short period of time.
"Please! If the performance is not achieved, my mother will take the restaurant back and hand it over to professional managers. Then I will have nothing and life will be very boring." Yu Danneng only has two things to be busy with in his life, one is to take care of this restaurant, and the other is to actively marry himself off.
"Instead of putting your hope on me, why not have a good blind date and wait for your good news." He patted his friend on the shoulder like this.
"Sure enough, heroes and women think alike." After Yu Wuneng finished speaking, he waved to her and jumped into a taxi.
The taxi quickly drove away from the scene, but no one noticed a black car following it.
Stepping into the restaurant with such strides, passing through the outdoor garden area in the front courtyard, and walking directly into the European-style counter with familiar familiarity.
Standing at the counter were the restaurant staff responsible for the checkout tonight and Brother Gao, the restaurant chef.
"So, are you here?" Brother Gao was dressed in a snow-white chef's outfit, with his hands on his hips. Seeing So, his serious rectangular face smiled, revealing his white teeth.
"Brother Gao." Rusu put the things in his hands on the shelf under the counter first, took the black apron uniform he handed over, and quickly put it on. "How's business tonight?"
"There are only two or three guests, but one group has reserved a table." Brother Gao doesn't need to look at the order. He knows how many groups of guests have made reservations that day and how many people there are.
"How many people?"
"Thirteen people."
He frowned slightly and then relaxed, and began to make calculations in his mind. It was simply a fantasy for thirteen people to break through 100,000.
"Here, here we come." Brother Gao pursed his lips towards the door.
Turning her head to look in the direction he indicated, she was stunned for a moment when she saw who was coming. After two seconds, she slowly raised the corners of her mouth, picked up the menu on the counter, lightly pressed her left hand on the shoulder of the waiter who was about to greet him, hummed "I'll go", and then set out with confident steps.
"Hello, what would you like to order?"
As she was about to hand out the restaurant menu, a man with messy curly hair looked at her and waved his hand, indicating that there was no need to hand out the menu.
"Serve all the most delicious dishes in your restaurant! I won't go home until I'm drunk tonight!" The curly-haired man's face was slightly red and he was very excited.
"That's right, we're here to celebrate tonight by eating and drinking all over the place!"
Others enthusiastically agreed, and some even raised their right hands and made fists.
Only the aloof man sat quietly on the chair, not saying a word from beginning to end, and looked the calmest among the group of people, with his signature sarcastic smile on his lips.
"Are you referring to the dishes in the hidden menu?" Looking at this group of people, an idea suddenly flashed in his mind, and a smile slowly appeared.
